newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks optimistic about FY97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks optimistic about FY97 earnings.

text.p: Starbucks Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Howard Schultz said Thursday he is "very optimistic" about the company's ability to meet Wall Street's consensus estimate of $0.70 a share for fiscal 1997.
In the fiscal year ended Sept. 29, 1996, Starbucks reported a profit of $0.54 a share.
At a news conference following the company's annual meeting, Schultz said he was comfortable the company would post same store sales increases this fiscal year in the mid-single digit range.
Schultz said company executives have been watching coffee prices carefully and he said the company plans to make an announcement on its strategy within the next several days.

He declined to say whether Starbucks will raise retail prices. But he said the company has waited because it did not want to "rush to judgement" and raise prices without a good understanding of the forces driving the recent price volatility.
